BibleStudyProgram.heading: A 5-phase path from first question to being sent.
BibleStudyProgram.description: AM's 5-phase Bible Study Program is an online discipleship and Bible education program that leads students through a systematic flow of learning the Gospel of Jesus Christ and the life of faith. The program groups students with Bible teachers who will give instruction according to the listener's schedule. It culminates with the opportunity to volunteer, train as a student missionary, or simply dive deeper into the Word of God with AM.

Ministries.heading: Four steps, and we walk every one of them with you.
Ministries.connectDescription: AM offers various Bible study programs that nurture our spiritual life and relationship with the Lord Jesus Christ.
Ministries.growDescription: Join our Group Activities and mature together in the fellowship of truth. Our Group programs provide high-quality experiences for every student to gain spiritual strength.
Ministries.leadDescription: AM is happy to welcome students interested in volunteering and serving through their God given talents in various departments.
Ministries.sentDescription: AM will continue to walk with you until your precious calling of "being sent" is fulfilled in your life even after your graduation!

OurMission.statementSuffix: — fostering a Christ-centred network of young Christians for the mobilisation of campus mission.
OurMission.nameOrigin: The name apostolos is the Greek word for apostle. It means "one who is sent on a mission."
OurMission.history: What began as a small group of passionate young students in Los Angeles, California, eager to spread the gospel and make Jesus known, has become a global organisation working across university campuses around the world.
